title: 기업 이러닝에서 학습자가 지각한 만족감에 영향을 미치는 요인

abstracts.value: 이 연구의 목적은 기업 이러닝에서 학습자들의 만족도에 영향을 주는 요인들을 밝히기 위한 것이다. 국내 A 기업의 이러닝 학습자 681명을 대상으로 이러닝 학습에 대한 요인분석이 실시되었다. 연구에 사용된 설문은 CIPP모형에 근거하여 이러닝 학습에 영향을 미칠 수 있는 하위요인을 구성하였다. 요인분석의 결과를 종합해 보면 이러닝에 대한 학습자의 인식은 만족감이 높고 낮음에 따라 공통요인 6개와 개별요인 4-6개 추출되었다. 이와 같은 요인분석 결과를 근거로 하여 최종적으로 이러닝 학습에 대한 학습요인간의 영향력을 알아보기 위하여 회귀분석이 실시되었다. 연구 결과 만족감이 낮은 학습자들은 학습내용의 유용성, 규칙적인 학습, 학습활동에 대한 평가, 다양한 과정의 개설에 대한 요구가 만족감에 유의미한 영향을 미치고 있음을 확인할 수 있었다. 또한 만족감이 높은 학습자는 강사에 의한 학습안내, 적극적인 활용, 기능성의 편리성 등과 같이 적극적인 상호작용을 촉진시켜 줄 수 있는 요인에 따라서 이러닝 학습에 대한 만족감이 형성되고 있었다.

The purpose of this study was to identify the factors associated with levels of learners' satisfaction in corporate e-learning. Fifty seven items for learners' satisfaction survey were developed on the basis of the structure of the Context Input Process Product (CIPP) model, and 681 employees participated to this study. The participants were sampled from the same division of the company to ensure similar level of workplace environment. A factor analysis was conducted to identify factors associated with levels of learners' satisfaction in e-learning. Ten factor model was extracted for lower level satisfaction learner group, while twelve factor model for higher level satisfaction learner group. Between the two models for each group, six factors were identified across the groups: 1) usefulness of content, 2) regular based learning, 3) learning guide by instructor, 4) learning management, 5) competence diagnosis, and 6) functional usefulness. Follow-up analysis for regression was conducted to determine what factors make significant contribution for learners' satisfaction. For lower level satisfaction group, five factors were identified to make significant contribution to improve learners' satisfaction: 1) usefulness of content, 2) regular based learning, 3) evaluation for learning, 4) seeking help for learning, and 5) need for various courses. Interestingly, the factor of seeking help for learning has a negative impact on learners' satisfaction. It was interpreted that learners in low satisfaction level group tends to not seek instructor's help for their learning. For higher level satisfaction group, there were four factors to make significant contributions for learners' satisfaction: 1) learning guide by instructor, 2) active use of e-learning course, 3) functional usefulness, 4) usefulness of content. The result was concluded that learners in higher level satisfaction were more active and interactive than those in lower level satisfaction. The limitations of this study were 1) use of limited population for a specific company and 2) few consideration was considered for organization mood and workplace environment.
